svg.title: Designed variation AC-02
svg.desc: Accent movement within declension | Relation: Audible rather than segmental difference | वैदिक: Several ending classes move the pitch to the ending in cases where laukika | writing does not preserve the contrast | लौकिक: No separate laukika form recorded | Contribution: open · Evidence: form recorded · question open | Prevalence: open · grade U
